categories.main_business_segments: Empyrean Technology Co., Ltd. primarily develops, sells, and provides services for Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software tools used in integrated circuit (IC) design, manufacturing, and packaging. Their product portfolio includes full-process EDA tool systems for analog circuit design, storage circuit design, RF circuit design, digital circuit design, flat panel display circuit design, wafer manufacturing, and advanced packaging design. They also offer technical services such as IP solutions, wafer manufacturing engineering services, and related technical support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced EDA technologies including circuit simulation, layout editing, physical verification, parasitic parameter extraction, and reliability analysis. They develop full-process EDA toolchains tailored for analog, storage, RF, digital, and flat panel display circuits, integrating proprietary algorithms and high-performance computing techniques such as CPU-GPU heterogeneous simulation. Their tools support advanced semiconductor process nodes and automotive safety standards, and they utilize Python scripting for extensibility. They also develop specialized tools for wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging, including automated routing and physical verification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Empyrean serves integrated circuit design companies, wafer foundries, packaging enterprises, and flat panel display manufacturers. Their customers include domestic and international IC design firms focusing on analog, digital, storage, RF, and display chips, as well as semiconductor manufacturing and packaging companies. End markets span computing, communications, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, IoT, and aerospace sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing, China, with subsidiaries and offices in major Chinese cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Chengdu, Xi'an, and Guangzhou, as well as overseas subsidiaries in the United States, South Korea, Japan, and the Cayman Islands. Their sales are predominantly domestic (over 93%), with growing international revenue accounting for approximately 6.6% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Empyrean operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the development and provision of EDA software tools essential for IC design, wafer manufacturing, and packaging processes. They provide critical design automation solutions that enable chip designers and manufacturers to optimize and verify semiconductor products before fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on expanding full-process EDA tool coverage across analog, storage, RF, digital, flat panel display, wafer manufacturing, and advanced packaging domains. Key R&D initiatives include upgrading simulation and verification tools to support advanced process nodes, developing AI-enabled EDA capabilities, enhancing cloud-based EDA platforms, and integrating chip-system co-design methodologies. They also prioritize talent development, industry-academia collaboration, and strengthening their patent portfolio to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Empyrean generates revenue primarily through software licensing fees for its EDA tools, typically based on time-limited contracts. Additionally, they earn income from technical development services charged per project, and hardware and third-party software sales. The company employs a direct sales model supported by marketing and customer service teams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Globally, the EDA market is dominated by three leading companies: Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, and Siemens EDA. Empyrean is positioned in the second tier globally, recognized for its comprehensive full-process toolchains in specific domains such as analog, storage, and RF circuit design. Domestically, Empyrean holds the largest market share among Chinese EDA providers and is acknowledged as a national leader with strong technical capabilities and a broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Empyrean reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.01 billion, representing a 26.61% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 200.7 million, up 8.20%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of 67.77% of revenue, with over 1,000 employees including 774 R&D personnel. Total assets reached RMB 5.54 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash reserves. The company has expanded its consolidated scope through acquisitions and new subsidiaries, supporting its growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Empyrean offers the only domestic full-process EDA tool systems for analog, storage, and RF circuit design, with several products achieving international certifications and automotive safety standards compliance. Their integrated toolchains provide seamless design-to-verification workflows, improving design accuracy, reducing costs, and shortening development cycles. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive product coverage, high-performance simulation engines, advanced packaging design automation, and strong technical support services, enabling customers to achieve competitive advantages in semiconductor design and manufacturing.
